Requirement: Offerors shall propose a fixed monthly price for CLINs 0001 and 0002 and fully burdened hourly labor rates for CLIN 0003.

The Contractor shall provide all labor, supervision, materials and equipment necessary to perform facilities maintenance at the Riverbend Campus, comprising 14 buildings and approximately 620,000 square feet.
The Contractor shall provide a full-time on-site Program Manager who is authorized to make binding decisions on behalf of the Contractor.
The Program Manager must be available by telephone 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
The Contractor shall maintain a Quality Control Plan (QCP) and shall submit it to the Contracting Officer within 30 days after award.
The Contractor shall inspect each building monthly.
The Contractor shall record all findings in the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS).

The Contractor shall perform preventive maintenance on HVAC, electrical, plumbing and fire-protection systems in accordance with manufacturer recommendations and the approved Preventive Maintenance Schedule (CDRL A003).
The Contractor shall respond to emergency service calls within 1 hour of notification and shall restore critical systems within 4 hours.
Routine service calls shall be completed within 3 business days.
The Government shall provide office space, utilities and access to the CMMS for the Contractor's on-site staff.
Nothing in this section shall be construed to require the Contractor to perform capital construction or renovation.

The Contractor shall: (a) mow and edge all lawns at least weekly during the growing season; (b) clear snow and ice from walkways and parking areas within 6 hours of the end of a weather event; and (c) empty trash receptacles daily.
Custodial supplies must be environmentally preferable products in accordance with EPA guidelines.
The Contractor shall obtain written approval from the Contracting Officer's Representative (COR) before beginning any single repair expected to exceed $5,000.
The Contractor shall submit the Monthly Status Report (CDRL A001) by the fifth business day of each month.
The Contractor shall report any injury, property damage or safety incident to the COR within 24 hours using the Incident Report (CDRL A004).
The Contractor should also provide an Annual Energy Report (CDRL A006) within 30 days after the end of each period of performance.
The Contractor shall submit the Transition Plan (CDRL A005) within 10 days after award.
Deliverables shall be submitted electronically in Microsoft Office or Adobe PDF format.
All Contractor personnel shall undergo a background check before being granted unescorted access to the Riverbend Campus.
Contractor personnel must be U.S. citizens or lawful permanent residents.
Each employee must wear a Government-issued identification badge at all times while on the campus.
The Contractor shall maintain general liability insurance of at least $2.5 million per occurrence.
The Contractor shall furnish a performance bond of $1,000,000 within 15 days after award.
The Contractor shall comply with the Service Contract Labor Standards (FAR 52.222-41) and the wage determination attached to this solicitation.
Proposals shall be received no later than 2:00 PM Central Time on January 22, 2027.
Offerors must submit proposals electronically through the Example Agency Proposal Portal.
Offerors are required to submit proposals in four separate volumes: Volume I, Technical Approach; Volume II, Management and Staffing Plan; Volume III, Past Performance; and Volume IV, Price.
Volume I shall not exceed 25 pages, excluding resumes and cover pages.
Offerors shall provide at least three past performance references for contracts of similar size and scope completed within the last five years.
Questions about this solicitation must be submitted in writing by December 15, 2026, 4:00 PM CT.
Offerors must receive an acceptable rating on Factor 1 to be eligible for award.
